notes: modeling_safe.py is non-malicious but uses an UNREGISTERED API, so the linked code grades B-2 (not pure PASS).

Implemented policy is scan-and-decide: auto_map reroutes to the code validator. Dangerous linked code -> DENY/BLOCK (see hm-04); provably-safe grade-A code -> PASS; benign-but-unregistered or uncertain code -> REVIEW_REQUIRED (security owner gate).
Therefore the config trigger surfaces (CONFIG_TRIGGER_FIELD_FOUND) and routes the referenced code to review; the whole-system verdict is REVIEW_REQUIRED, not silent APPROVE.
